title: What we build.
label: DEMO PROJECT
name: ComedorUAGRM
description: Web and mobile system to apply for and preselect candidates for UAGRM's Beca Comedor (university meal scholarship). An artificial intelligence model preselects applications, computes a socioeconomic vulnerability score and prioritizes the files the DUBSS must audit, with Business Intelligence dashboards. It replaces the manual review of about 20,000 files per term.
